items.label: QueueIQ score
items.description: See why this post or comment ranks where it does.

bannedKeywords.label: Banned keywords (comma-separated)
bannedKeywords.helpText: Matched against post titles/bodies and comment text. Each match adds +5 to the urgency score.
bannedKeywords.defaultValue: spam, scam, phishing, giveaway, free money

lowKarmaThreshold.label: Low karma threshold
lowKarmaThreshold.helpText: Authors below this total karma (link + comment) get +4 urgency.

scoreWeightReports.label: Points per report
scoreWeightReports.helpText: Multiplied by report count. Change here, then refresh the dashboard.

scoreWeightKeywords.label: Points per banned keyword
scoreWeightKeywords.helpText: Multiplied by keyword matches in title/body.

scoreWeightLowKarma.label: Low-karma author bonus
scoreWeightLowKarma.helpText: Flat points when author is below the karma threshold.

scoreWeightRepeatReports.label: Points per repeat report
scoreWeightRepeatReports.helpText: Multiplied by extra report events beyond the first.
